d2c0f14bade33222.answer: {"subreddit":"pettyrevenge","title":"I Gave His Refund Exactly as Requested","script":"The entitled customer slammed his phone beside my register and demanded a refund for a latte he had already finished. He claimed the foam was wrong, tossed a $5 bill on the floor, and promised a nasty review unless I handed him cash immediately. My manager checked the empty cup, then quietly approved the refund request under one condition: every refunded item had to be returned. I printed the receipt, opened a clean takeaway cup, and asked him to return the missing drink. He laughed until I placed the policy sheet beside his empty cup and circled the line he had ignored. With the queue watching, he admitted he could not return it. I picked up his $5 bill, dropped it into the tip jar, and canceled the refund. The door slammed behind him, but his threatened review never appeared; the security camera had recorded his entire performance.","hashtags":["pettyrevenge","cafe","entitledcustomer","karma"],"shots":[{"phrase":"slammed his phone","query":"angry customer"},{"phrase":"$5 bill","query":"cash floor"},{"phrase":"refund request","query":"paper receipt"},{"phrase":"empty cup","query":"coffee cup"},{"phrase":"policy sheet","query":"store policy"},{"phrase":"tip jar","query":"tip jar"},{"phrase":"security camera","query":"security camera"}],"punches":[{"phrase":"slammed his phone","text":"HE SNAPPED","color":"#ff3030"},{"phrase":"refund request","text":"FULL REFUND","color":"#ffaa30"},{"phrase":"tip jar","text":"TIP SECURED","color":"#50ff80"},{"phrase":"security camera","text":"ALL RECORDED","color":"#ffffff"}],"music_vibe":"cinematic"}

5154886221728877.answer: {"subreddit":"MaliciousCompliance","title":"I Followed My Manager's Replacement Rule Perfectly","script":"My manager replaced our strongest hardware clerk with a brand-new temp, then ordered me to stop helping customers outside my aisle. The temp was friendly but had never used the cutting machine, so a contractor asked me for help with a rush order. I pointed to the written rule and called the manager instead. He arrived annoyed, tried the machine himself, and cut every board 2 inches short. The contractor refused the pile and demanded the store cover the wasted material. Suddenly my manager wanted me to fix everything before closing. I followed his rule again and stayed in my aisle while he recut 40 boards alone. The next morning, the regional supervisor reviewed the loss report, restored my cross-training duties, and assigned the temp to shadow me for 2 weeks. My manager's replacement plan lasted exactly one shift, while the new clerk became the best teammate I had.","hashtags":["MaliciousCompliance","hardwarestore","workplacejustice","karma"],"shots":[{"phrase":"brand-new temp","query":"new employee"},{"phrase":"cutting machine","query":"wood saw"},{"phrase":"written rule","query":"printed policy"},{"phrase":"2 inches short","query":"short boards"},{"phrase":"40 boards alone","query":"lumber stack"},{"phrase":"regional supervisor","query":"office supervisor"},{"phrase":"2 weeks","query":"training session"}],"punches":[{"phrase":"replaced our strongest","text":"REPLACED","color":"#ff3030"},{"phrase":"2 inches short","text":"CUT WRONG","color":"#ffaa30"},{"phrase":"40 boards alone","text":"DO IT YOURSELF","color":"#ff3030"},{"phrase":"best teammate","text":"BEST HIRE","color":"#50ff80"}],"music_vibe":"cinematic"}

6d3379c3e8797994.answer: {"subreddit":"TalesFromTheCustomer","title":"I Exposed the Fake VIP at Check-In","script":"A man swept into the rental office wearing a tailored coat and announced that the premium car outside was reserved for him, even though my confirmation showed a compact. He demanded I move aside while he lectured the clerk about how important guests should be treated. The clerk stayed calm and asked for the reservation code. He flashed a screenshot, but the code belonged to the woman waiting quietly behind him. When he insisted she must have copied it, I noticed his screenshot included her name at the top. I said it aloud, and the entire lobby went silent. The clerk called security, upgraded the woman for free, and handed the man directions to the economy counter across the terminal. He left dragging 3 oversized bags while the real customer drove away in the premium car. His grand entrance bought him nothing except a longer walk.","hashtags":["TalesFromTheCustomer","rentaloffice","entitledcustomer","karma"],"shots":[{"phrase":"rental office","query":"car rental"},{"phrase":"premium car","query":"luxury car"},{"phrase":"reservation code","query":"phone screenshot"},{"phrase":"waiting quietly","query":"waiting customer"},{"phrase":"called security","query":"security guard"},{"phrase":"3 oversized bags","query":"large luggage"},{"phrase":"longer walk","query":"airport hallway"}],"punches":[{"phrase":"premium car","text":"FAKE VIP","color":"#ff3030"},{"phrase":"her name","text":"WRONG NAME","color":"#ffaa30"},{"phrase":"upgraded the woman","text":"FREE UPGRADE","color":"#50ff80"},{"phrase":"longer walk","text":"KEEP WALKING","color":"#ffffff"}],"music_vibe":"hiphop"}

a8e0806f155184e4.answer: {"subreddit":"pettyrevenge","title":"I Ended Their Airport Line Rivalry","script":"Two travelers turned my airport gate into a shouting match over who had reached the charging outlet first. Each claimed the other had shoved ahead, and both demanded I remove the rival from the waiting area. I was not gate staff, just a technician replacing a broken power strip, but they ignored every explanation. Finally I unplugged the strip, held up the red inspection tag, and said the outlet had failed its safety check. Their argument stopped instantly. They rushed across the terminal toward the only other charging station, dragging bags and blaming each other the whole way. Then I installed the new strip, plugged in my tools, and invited the 6 quiet passengers nearby to charge first. The rivals returned 20 minutes later to find every socket occupied and boarding already announced. Their contest for first place put both of them at the back of the line.","hashtags":["pettyrevenge","airport","entitledtravelers","karma"],"shots":[{"phrase":"airport gate","query":"airport gate"},{"phrase":"charging outlet","query":"wall outlet"},{"phrase":"power strip","query":"power strip"},{"phrase":"red inspection tag","query":"warning tag"},{"phrase":"6 quiet passengers","query":"waiting passengers"},{"phrase":"20 minutes later","query":"terminal clock"},{"phrase":"back of the line","query":"boarding line"}],"punches":[{"phrase":"shouting match","text":"GATE FIGHT","color":"#ff3030"},{"phrase":"failed its safety check","text":"OUT OF ORDER","color":"#ffaa30"},{"phrase":"6 quiet passengers","text":"QUIET WINS","color":"#50ff80"},{"phrase":"back of the line","text":"DEAD LAST","color":"#ffffff"}],"music_vibe":"hiphop"}

fcb48cd2c487f6fa.answer: {"subreddit":"r/MaliciousCompliance","title":"My Manager's Confession Form Fired Him Instead","script":"My manager blamed me for $600 missing from the roadside shop, then ordered me to sign a confession before lunch. I had opened alone during a storm, handled 3 busloads, and closed the register exactly once. He said the cameras were down and threatened to dock my next 4 checks. I refused to sign, so he sent me home and told the owner I had admitted everything. That night, I remembered the spare receipt printer in the stockroom. It logged every cash drawer opening, including manager overrides. The next morning I brought the paper roll to the owner. There were 6 overrides after my shift, all under my manager's code, plus a refund for an item still sitting on the shelf. He went pale and called it a software glitch. The owner compared the timestamps to the hallway camera and found him pocketing the cash. My confession form became his termination notice.","hashtags":["rmaliciouscompliance","workplace","manager","receipts"],"shots":[{"phrase":"sign a confession","query":"confession paper"},{"phrase":"opened alone","query":"empty shop"},{"phrase":"cameras were down","query":"security camera"},{"phrase":"spare receipt printer","query":"receipt printer"},{"phrase":"6 overrides","query":"cash register"},{"phrase":"hallway camera","query":"hallway camera"},{"phrase":"termination notice","query":"fired employee"}],"punches":[{"phrase":"My manager blamed me","text":"BLAMED ME","color":"#ff3030"},{"phrase":"dock my next 4 checks","text":"4 CHECKS","color":"#ffaa30"},{"phrase":"6 overrides after my shift","text":"6 OVERRIDES","color":"#ff3030"},{"phrase":"his termination notice","text":"HE GOT FIRED","color":"#50ff80"}],"music_vibe":"cinematic"}

97199b1b644f8661.answer: {"subreddit":"r/TalesFromRetail","title":"I Found Her Bracelet Before She Framed Me","script":"A customer accused me of losing her $3,000 bracelet at the pet daycare and demanded my paycheck before I could check the cameras. She said she had handed it to me with her dog's leash, but I remembered receiving only a blue bag. My manager believed her immediately and locked the front door so I could not leave. While she threatened to call the police, I pulled up the intake video. It showed her removing the bracelet in the lobby, wrapping it in a tissue, and dropping it into her own coat pocket. She insisted the angle was misleading and emptied her purse on the counter. Nothing. Then her dog started tugging at the same coat hanging behind her. The bracelet slid out with the tissue still around it. My manager apologized and offered her a free week. She refused, grabbed the bracelet, and stormed out. The next morning, the owner promoted me and ended the manager's refund privileges.","hashtags":["rtalesfromretail","petdaycare","workplace","karma"],"shots":[{"phrase":"$3,000 bracelet","query":"gold bracelet"},{"phrase":"blue bag","query":"blue bag"},{"phrase":"locked the front door","query":"locked door"},{"phrase":"intake video","query":"security footage"},{"phrase":"coat pocket","query":"coat pocket"},{"phrase":"tugging at the same coat","query":"dog tugging"},{"phrase":"promoted me","query":"employee promotion"}],"punches":[{"phrase":"A customer accused me","text":"ACCUSED ME","color":"#ff3030"},{"phrase":"demanded my paycheck","text":"MY PAYCHECK","color":"#ffaa30"},{"phrase":"own coat pocket","text":"HER POCKET","color":"#ffffff"},{"phrase":"promoted me","text":"I GOT PROMOTED","color":"#50ff80"}],"music_vibe":"hiphop"}

ee1410b7ac58c539.answer: {"subreddit":"r/MaliciousCompliance","title":"I Served Exactly What My Supervisor Approved","script":"My supervisor ordered me to serve 40 lunches from a refrigerator that had been warm for 3 hours, then put his approval in writing. I worked the café beside a small aquarium exhibit, and the morning temperature alarm would not stop beeping. I moved every tray into the backup fridge and marked them unsafe. He stormed in before the tour group arrived, called me dramatic, and emailed, “Serve everything as planned.” So I printed the message, taped it above the empty display, and served exactly what he approved: sealed crackers and bottled water. When the group leader asked why, I handed over the temperature log and his email. She canceled the catering charge but praised the safety call. The owner arrived furious about the lost sale until the repair technician confirmed the fridge had failed overnight. My supervisor tried to delete his email.
